Consequently, interpreting every large coefficient as evidence of a frequently encountered object would be misleading. Without initialization information, input examples, or a clearly recoverable spatial pattern, I cannot reliably separate task-relevant structure from otherwise uninformative coefficients.

I cannot substantiate any of those signatures here. None of these candidates is convincingly ruled out by the output layer either.
